Şifresini bildiğin dosyadan şifreyi kald: Removes the password from a file whose password you know.
Yazar, program, XMP, gömülü dosyalar, Ja: Author, producer, XMP, embedded files, JavaScript.
Açılmayan ya da hatalı PDF'i yeniden yaz: Rewrites a PDF that won't open or has errors.
Şifreler kaydedilmez; unutursan dosya aç: Passwords aren't saved; if you forget yours, the file can't be opened. Not every reader honors permission restrictions; the open password is the real protection.
Şifreli dosyayı bırakınca şifresi sorulu: When you drop an encrypted file, you'll be asked for its password. There's no password cracking; restrictions can only be removed from restricted files without an open password — for your own files.
Görünen içerik değişmez. Sonuçta neyin s: The visible content doesn't change. The result lists what was removed.
Önce qpdf'in onarımı, olmazsa MuPDF'in k: qpdf's repair is tried first, then MuPDF's recovery if that fails.
Sahip şifresi açılış şifresinden farklı: The owner password must differ from the open password; if they match, the permission restrictions aren't applied.
